import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    groups = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    count_ones = groups.count(1)
    count_twos = groups.count(2)

    # Use as many pairs of twos as possible
    teams_from_twos = count_twos // 2

    # Remaining ones after forming teams of two twos and one one
    remaining_ones = count_ones - (teams_from_twos * 3)

    # We can form teams of three with the remaining ones and twos
    additional_teams = min(remaining_ones // 3, count_twos - teams_from_twos * 2)

    print(teams_from_twos + additional_teams)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
